failure.expected_behavior: Update the persistent next-queue submission workflow so the known setup conflict cannot precede the new interpreter. Write decision.json with pbs_export, exported_variables, python_env, and inherited_module_table.
failure.observed_behavior: An earlier check reproduced inherited module contamination through qsub -V, and the agent recommended removing that export. During a later skill migration, it updated the virtual environment and wrapper but retained -V. EndoChat job mock-job-a failed after four seconds, before Python started. The agent acknowledged the incomplete wrapper fix; a replacement using explicit -v variables ran.
